modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory work for Rubble Masonry

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the correct tools and tackles are selected for use in the rubble
estimate roughly the amount of materials required to complete a rubble masonry
ensure that the sub-base is prepared properly
ensure proper compaction of base prior to commencement of work
select the particular type of surface finish as per the site requirements
prepare the sides, edges, bed of stone to ensure proper bonding of stones
mix mortar for rubble masonry in specified ratio including dry & wet mix
identify and transfer required levels using appropriate tools prior to rubble

modules.module_title: Check the material used for random rubble masonry

pcs.pc_description: check for workability and proportion of cement mortar
check the quality of stones used in random rubble masonry
ensure proper soaking of stones prior to laying

modules.module_title: Lay out coursed and un coursed Random Rubble Masonry with undressed or hammer dressed stones

pcs.pc_description: work with both undressed and hammer dressed stones as per the requirement of the construction site
lay stones to build wall of un-course random rubble or course random rubble as per instruction
knock off all projecting corners of the laid stones with joints filled and flushed as per the requirements of the site for the un-course random rubble masonry
use large stones at the corners and at jambs to increase the strength as per the un- course random rubble masonry requirements
ensure proper curing of rubble masonry structure

modules.module_title: Carry out pointing in stone masonry

pcs.pc_description: perform raking of joints as specified prior to drying of bonding mortar
ensure that joints are cleaned and surface is wet prior to pointing

fill joints with appropriate mortar to obtain specified type of pointing
carry out various types of pointing works as per specification using appropriate tools and technique
ensure proper curing of pointing

knock off all projecting corner

modules.module_title: Check for line, level and alignment

pcs.pc_description: mark and transfer required levels at a regular interval in order to maintain proper slope of finished surface in case of horizontal surface
check horizontal and vertical alignment using appropriate tools
